method: 每项保持纸源或独立音证支持的正文词，仅映射到同一实际完整词声段；无猜秒、无词尾/词内比例插值、无全局不同词合并。

bindings.source_sentence_en: So, what we tend to do when it comes to power is that we complement the other’s non-verbals.

bindings.source_sentence_en: What we find is that when you’re in the higher power pose condition, 86% of you will gamble.
